eyebrow: Search for Common Ground · Imagine If year-end campaign · Campaign video, script Version 2
title: Imagine If:
headline: Search's year-end campaign film, Version 2: open quiet on the future, cut to division, then sound, feel and taste what common ground looks like.
story: The world tells us it runs on sides. Search for Common Ground asks a different question: what becomes possible when we find common ground?
Three voices from the field (Emmanuel, Helene, Pesh) and three small stories (a rumor stopped, a fight over resources turned into a shared system, a woman trusted to lead) show it working.
It starts with one person, then ten, then a community. The close: your gift is matched, dollar for dollar, up to $100,000.
do: Build it from the Version 2 script exactly.
Open quiet and slow on hands, light, something growing.
Change tone hard on “We're told the world runs on sides.”
Use the three senses (sound, feel, taste) as chapter beats.
dont: No logo, wordmark or title card at 0:00.
Don't paraphrase or trim the script.
No generic stock for the three stories. If a story has no footage, flag it on the item.
No freeze frames on a speaker.
